description: Normal ARP traffic with consistent IP-MAC mappings, standard request/reply patterns, and reasonable timing.
A previously known IP address suddenly appears with a different MAC address, simulating an ARP cache poisoning attempt.
An attacker forges ARP replies claiming to be the network gateway with a malicious MAC address.
Multiple different MAC addresses claim the same IP address, which should trigger DUPLICATE_IP_CLAIM detection.
Unsolicited ARP replies with forged MAC addresses sent without any preceding ARP request.
A single MAC address sends ARP packets at an abnormally high rate, simulating an ARP flood / DDoS precursor.
